generated_cypher:
MATCH (m:Museum)<-[:displayedAt]-(s1:Sculpture)
MATCH (m)<-[:displayedAt]-(s2:Sculpture)
WHERE s1.name = 'J. B. van Berckelaer' AND s2.name = 'Women Wrestlers'
RETURN m.name AS museum_name
answer: Both the sculptures 'J. B. van Berckelaer' and 'Women Wrestlers' are displayed at the National Gallery of Art.

generated_cypher:

  AND (toLower(g.name) =~ '.*battle.*' OR toLower(g.name) =~ '.*war.*' OR toLower(g.aliases) =~ '.*battle.*' OR toLower(g.aliases) =~ '.*war.*')
